messages:
Marta (Marketing): Quick sprint request — make a 1-pager 'Deploy Selector Brief' for next Wed webinar. Goal: help enterprise buyers choose Hosted / Dedicated / Private in one glance. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Dev (Product): Keep it micro: 3-column table, 3 benchmark callouts (label 'example workload'), migration path, and one-line runtime note about KV caching.
Rae (Field): Must include KMS/HSM support, VPC peering, audit-log retention (90/365 days), and a Banking example. Also include 1-line discovery snippets.
Hope (Sales): Routing rules needed: SDR->AE->SE. Keep thresholds simple. CTA: 15-min infra consult link for post.
Marta (Marketing): Draft layout I propose:
- Header 1-sentence + Risk / Speed / Cost pill
- Core 3-column compare (Security | SLA & latency | Cost at scale | Time to ship)
- Right: 3 small benchmark callouts + 3 persona micro-lines
- Footer: routing YAML + webinar CTA
Dev (Product): Benchmarks (example workload): Hosted 95th~110ms @1k qps (128 tokens); Dedicated reserved GPUs -> ~35% lower unit cost at >1M tokens/day. Add note: Dedicated = SLA-backed latency tiers; Hosted = best-effort with region fallback.
Rae (Field): Persona snippets:
- Platform Lead: "Dedicated for predictable throughput & private networking."
- CISO: "Private with customer KMS + audit logs meets regulated controls."
- PM: "Hosted for fastest iteration; streaming + tool integrations."
Hope (Sales): Routing pseudo-rules (ops-friendly):
```yaml
if requires_hsm or data_residency == true:
  route: AE+SE
elif projected_tokens_per_day >= 1_000_000:
  route: AE (dedicated)
else:
  route: SDR -> nurture
```
pdf-bot: uploaded 1777777777-deploy-selector-brief-v0.pdf
Marta (Marketing): Copy notes: main blurb <120 words, conservative claims, two-tone header, accessible PDF + one-slide. Timeline: I draft tonight, Dev validate AM, Rae field examples by noon, Hope routes to ops PM. Final for webinar pre-read Friday AM.
Dev (Product): ack. I'll verify numbers and add a one-line migration: Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private.
Rae (Field): Will paste Banking example and discovery lines into this thread by EOD.
Hope (Sales): I'll prepare AE talking points once copy locks. 
Marta (Marketing): thanks team. Ping me if blocked. :white_check_mark:
